name: Elena south junction lawns · photographed planting, lamp and street sign
about: Show-details pieces on structure reviewed in docs/reviews/elena-junction-lawns-roof, from the Elena 24 roof photos (ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17, IMG_2358, IMG_2367) and the lane views (IMG_2261, IMG_2262, IMG_2330): the two cypresses at the far wall, bougainvillea and vines on the walls, the lamp post in the east hedge bed and the CALLE ELENA tile sign. Drawn by src/elena-junction-details.ts; every piece keeps the shared route guard with its whole footprint. The lawn trees are in data/junction_lawns.json.

climbers.basis: Bougainvillea trained over the west wall from just past the CALLE ELENA plaques to the bed door (the stretch with the plaques is bare but for a thin vine), magenta, with shrubs at its foot (ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17, IMG_2358, IMG_2261).
The bougainvillea carries on past the lawn door (IMG_2261, ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17).
A climber trained along the west wall beside the far lawn, sparse with the wall showing (ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17, IMG_2358).
Vines trained along the top of the cypress wall (ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17, IMG_2358, IMG_2261).
Bougainvillea over the corner house's patio wall behind the hedge bed, pink and orange (IMG_2358, IMG_2367).

lamp.basis: Black lantern post standing in the hedge bed on the east side of the lane near the junction (IMG_2358, IMG_2367, ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17; base cast through the roof camera to about 1.5 m along and 1.4 m east of the centreline, ±0.5 m).

sign.basis: Two tile plaques, CALLE and ELENA in dark capitals on white tiles, on the lawn-side face of the west wall near its north end (IMG_2262, IMG_2286, ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17).
